market_context: November 27, 2026 is a Black Friday shortened session: NYSE and Nasdaq equity trading closes at 1:00 PM ET, so there will be no regular-session 4:00 PM close. Pre-market reports showed a broad risk-on rebound, with Nasdaq-100 futures up roughly 2.2%-2.5%, S&P 500 futures near +1.8%, Nvidia up nearly 4%, and VIX lower; no major U.S. economic release is scheduled after the morning trade/inventory data.

predictions.reasoning: Pre-market index-futures reporting points to an approximately 1.8% S&P 500 advance, which implies SPY near 729 before allowing for some fade during the abbreviated, lower-liquidity session. The VIX is already down 5.52% from the supplied snapshot and the rebound is broad after the recent five-day pullback.

Nasdaq-100 futures were reported up about 2.2%-2.5% pre-market, with chip shares leading the rebound. QQQ has fallen 3.9% over five days and the strongest stated pre-market leadership is in beaten-down AI and semiconductor names, supporting a larger rebound than SPY.

Morning market reports put Nvidia nearly 4% higher pre-market after its 3.91% prior-session decline. That indicates dip-buying in the AI complex, although the target assumes some trimming from the implied opening strength in the short holiday session.

Amazon enters Black Friday after an 8.7% five-day decline, while reports describe broad tech-led risk appetite returning before the open. Black Friday spending headlines are supportive for retail sentiment, but extended discounting and the weak recent trend keep confidence moderate.
